_comment: Node-local prompt templates, keyed by capability id. Each value is a Python str.format() template; {field} placeholders are filled from the job payload (the capability's declared fields in docs.js). These are CONTENT decisions, not architecture — replace the placeholders below with the real prompt engineering. worker.py renders these; it never embeds a prompt string. The ANSWER is not free either: a structured capability's model output must be one JSON object carrying the fields its `resolves` declares (parse-task / breakdown-goal / parse-document: {"items": [...], "defaults": {...}}; widget-generate: {"spec": {...}}) — and a literal brace in a template is doubled, {{ }}, because it is str.format(), or the job lands FAILED. `query` is open-ended — its text becomes {"response": text}.
parse-task:
Extract a single structured task from the following text. Respond with JSON only, as {{"items": [{{"title": "…"}}]}}.

Text: {text}
breakdown-goal:
Break the following goal into an ordered list of milestones. Respond with JSON only, as {{"items": [ … ]}}.

Goal: {goal_text}
widget-generate:
Produce a WidgetSpec JSON document for the following description. Respond with JSON only, as {{"spec": {{ … }}}}.

Description: {description}
query:
You are a triage router. Classify the intent of the following query and respond with JSON only.

Query: {text}
